title: connector-github: ship `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` for `search_issues` and `issue_read`, digests measured against GitHub's live MCP server, so the listing's sha256 is the pin set (ruling 6556740185, #28590 B)
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ④ execution of a maintainer ruling. Ruling 6556740185 on #28590 (letter B, maintainer 「28590 27855 同意」 2026-11-01T10:29Z) requires every MCP connector app on the shelf to ship `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` for every tool it includes. The listing's `sha256` is the digest of that pin set. Child of #27293 (E4). ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling-ref: 6556740185

## Work

`packages/apps/connector-github/src/connectors/github.connector.ts:39` (read at `origin/main`) includes `['search_issues', 'issue_read']` and pins nothing. Do the following:
- Add `providerConfig.toolsSnapshot` with one sha256 per included tool. Take the digests as `computeMcpToolsSnapshot` (`@objectstack/connector-mcp`, PR #28515) computes them over the live `tools/list` answer of `https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/`, with the headers the app already sends (`X-MCP-Readonly: true`). Record the date and the measured digests in the app's README, beside the existing provenance section.
- Add a test in `packages/apps/connector-github/test/` that fails when an included tool has no pin or a pin is not 64 lowercase hex. It must stay offline (no live call in CI).
- Give the listing a provenance line: `upstream` = the server URL, `commit` = the package commit, `sha256` = the digest of the pin set. The digest is `stableStringify` of the record, then sha256. Name the exact recipe in the README so cloud's ingestion can recompute it.
- Re-pinning when GitHub changes a tool is the shelf's routine. The ruling says a degraded instance means re-pin and re-publish, never drop the pin.

**Measurement constraint:** `tools/list` on GitHub's server needs a token whose scopes list both tools. A session without one cannot measure the digests. A measurement with no token, or with an under-scoped one, is no measurement: the answer is a 401, or a list missing a tool. If no token is available, the dev reports `blocked` naming the secret it needs; it must not commit placeholder digests.

## Business reason

#27293's Done-when gives each shelf listing a verifiable `upstream`, `commit` and `sha256`. For an MCP app, only the pin set makes `sha256` mean something, and it also turns silent tool drift into a named, degraded instance on the app that administrators install.

## Reader

The epic PM of #27293 dispatches it (`domain:server`, `packages/apps/*`). Cloud seat 2 reads the provenance recipe for its ingestion (#28278).

## Dedupe

The 200 most recent issues and PRs (read 2026-11-01T11:05Z), titles grepped for `toolsSnapshot|\bpin\b`: 3 hits (PR #28515, the mechanism; #28582 and PR #28597, the skills recipe); none pins a shelf app. Control `connector`: 21 hits.
